channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Trump's $1 trillion-plus 'dividend' plan meets immediate bipartisan pushback
item.description: Such a payout could cost more than $1 trillion and is likely to face legal obstacles.

item.title: The likelihood of a Fed interest rate hike next week just got a lot higher
item.description: Traders pushed chances for a rate increase to 70% in morning action.

item.title: Kimmel says interview with Senate candidate Talarico won't air on ABC amid FCC threats
item.description: ABC has come under increased pressure from the FCC, and the Trump administration has raised concerns about equal air time for political candidates.

item.title: Stocks retreat as U.S. oil prices top $100, threatening economy: Live updates
item.description: The first of two inflation reports due this week is in focus as oil prices rise.

item.title: Ford announces $1 billion investment at Kentucky plant following DOT criticism
item.description: Ford Motor on Thursday announced a $1 billion investment to build a new paint shop at its crucial truck plant in Kentucky.

item.title: 30-year fixed mortgage rate tops 7% for the first time in over a year
item.description: The average rate on the 30-year fixed mortgage crossed over 7% for the first time in more than a year, as home prices continue to rise and sales drop.

item.title: Josh Brown says Apple's stock chart just gave you a classic 'tell.' What it means
item.description: Josh and Sean review two stock pullbacks they believe are refreshers rather than rally-enders for both names.

item.title: Apple makes biggest change to iPhone release cadence in 7 years in Ternus' first showcase as CEO
item.description: In John Ternus' first launch event as CEO, Apple announced its first foldable phone and the iPhone 18 Pro.

item.title: Pilot pressed on with landing despite warnings in Miami cargo crash, NTSB says
item.description: The NTSB said pilots continued with the landing of an Amazon cargo plane despite pilot and cockpit warnings about approach speed ahead of its Miami crash.

item.title: Wholesale prices rose 0.4% in August, as expected
item.description: The producer price index was expected to rise 0.4% in August, according to the Dow Jones consensus forecast.

item.title: 'Extinction' warnings ramp up as more OpenAI, Anthropic researchers join calls for an AI slowdown
item.description: There is growing concern globally about the capability of AI, following numerous cyberattacks and security incidents in recent months by rogue models

item.title: Bond sell-off, stock boom: Why rebalancing is a good strategy right now
item.description: With stocks near all-time highs and bonds selling off, it's likely a good time for investors to consider rebalancing to their target risk, advisors said.

item.title: Humans need to 'surf the wave' of AI rather than get swallowed by it, Chesky says at Communacopia
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi, and SpaceX CFO Bret Johnsen are set to speak at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference.

item.title: September Monthly Meeting: Jim Cramer reveals his favorite 6 stocks to buy now
item.description: There will be no Morning Meeting on September 10. Join Jim Cramer for the September Monthly Meeting on September 10 at 12 p.m. ET. Jim and Jeff Marks also provide their broader market outlook and update their views on all the stocks in the Club portfolio.

item.title: U.S. crude oil tops $100 again – last seen in May – as market braces for prolonged Iran war
item.description: Oil prices remain elevated amid worries that escalating tensions in the Middle East could further exacerbate supply disruptions

item.title: U.S. Supreme Court again rejects push to use Trump-backed congressional maps in midterms, clearing the way for old maps
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court rejected a push to use Missouri congressional maps backed by President Trump ahead of November midterm elections.

item.title: Home sales fall in August despite the highest supply in over a decade
item.description: Home sales slowed again despite the highest supply of homes for sale in over a decade. Prices, however, continue to rise.

item.title: Kalshi launches ‘perps’ for gold and silver following CFTC approval, expanding futures offerings
item.description: Its the latest move by the prediction market company to diversify its assets users can trade.

item.title: Starbucks CEO Brian Niccol says next stage of turnaround focuses on cafe makeovers, customer experience
item.description: Starbucks is now two years into its turnaround under CEO Brian Niccol.

item.title: Wall Street firm believes the AI stock market boom is 'nearing an end.' Here's why
item.description: Stretched earnings expectations, extreme concentration and surging equity issuance point to growing bubble risks.

item.title: Starbucks is back, CEO Brian Niccol says. Here is what he's focused on next
item.description: Niccol added that he aims to "finish the job on uplifting all of our coffeehouses."

item.title: Here’s how to get into the top-ranked U.S. airport lounges with credit cards
item.description: You'll need premium cards issued by Amex, Capital One or Chase to access these airport lounges.

item.title: Trump warns Tehran over Pickaxe Mountain activity; U.S.-Iran exchange attacks on ships near Hormuz
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has urged Iran "not to get cute" over activity at a suspected nuclear site on Pickaxe Mountain.

item.title: 10-year Treasury yield tops 4.9%, highest since 2023, as oil surge raises inflation fears
item.description: Treasury yields moved higher on Thursday as U.S. oil prices hit $100 per barrel.

item.title: Bessent’s political turn in GOP speech tests his bond-market credibility
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's Republican convention speech in Dallas is raising questions about how politics could affect market confidence in him.

item.title: NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell says league could rework TV packages in next media deal
item.description: The NFL has an opt-out clause at the end of the 2029-30 season in which it can resell and redistribute its media rights.

item.title: Macy's posts strong results, raises guidance as turnaround begins to take hold
item.description: Macy's posted strong fiscal second-quarter results on Thursday and raised its full-year guidance.

item.title: Where investors are finding income outside traditional bonds as rates rise
item.description: Bond volatility and rising rates have some investors looking beyond traditional bonds for income, from alternative fixed income to stocks and other strategies.

item.title: Nasdaq invests $100 million in Kraken parent, eyeing 2027 launch of 'tokenized' stock trading
item.description: Nasdaq is making a big bet that tokenization of stocks and other assets are becoming part of the plumbing of the stock market.

item.title: Amazon gives OpenAI's ad business a boost, letting its advertisers into ChatGPT
item.description: Amazon has been hesitant to open its sprawling webstore to external AI platforms.
